## 9339b47bb5d5

**Reproduced issue: advertised exact controls are ignored.** With seed 117, sample index 5, difficulty `easy`, I requested `grid_h=18`, `grid_w=20`, `seed_count=1`, `palette_size=1`, and `n_distinct_colors=1`. The generator returned an 8×11 grid containing two seeds of two distinct colors, while `self_check()` returned no error. Thus at least five advertised controls do not describe generation behavior. The exact input, request, observation, source hash, and command are retained in `checks/audit/audit_findings.json`.

Possible downstream shortcut: because normal generation chooses at most one seed per compartment and ignores palette/count requests, lessons may teach only the current narrow compartment pattern rather than the advertised cross-product. I did not run a full repair battery; this audit establishes the concrete contract mismatch only.

triage.reason: Accepted as reviewer-reported, source-bound findings: 9339b47bb5d5 ignores requested dimensions/count/palette; 9c0ccdf0d414 generates colliding-quadrant motifs beyond its stated placement description. Current hashes match the audited sources; both remain unapproved. First-per-quadrant selection is existing Racket authority behavior, so the latter is retained as domain/description alignment work, not proof that canonical authority must change.
